crossRefs.note: Do you open your eyes on such a one, and bring me into judgment with you?
Against whom has the king of Israel come out? Whom do you pursue? A dead dog? A flea?
The nations will rush like the rushing of many waters: but he will rebuke them, and they will flee far off, and will be…
He won’t break a bruised reed. He won’t quench a smoking flax, until he leads justice to victory.

translations.web: Will you harass a driven leaf? Will you pursue the dry stubble?
translations.bsb: Would You frighten a windblown leaf? Would You chase after dry chaff?
translations.kjv: Wilt thou break a leaf driven to and fro? and wilt thou pursue the dry stubble?
translations.asv: Wilt thou harass a driven leaf? And wilt thou pursue the dry stubble?
